segments.name: option
segments.comment: Configuration option for the selected AGU. There are 4 options per port.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Selects which AGU is being configured: 0 = input AGU (gates row-buffer advance), 1 = offset AGU (selects lane offset for the barrel slice).

verbo_map.comment: Input AGU: its addr_valid pulses latch a new bulk line into the 2-line buffer (line_A <= line_B; line_B <= bulk_data_in). Address value is ignored.
Offset AGU: its addr_valid drives output enable; the low log2(BULK/WORD) bits of its address select the lane offset of the BULK-wide slice taken from {line_B, line_A}.

segments.name: init_addr_sd
segments.comment: Is initial address static or dynamic?

segments.name: init_addr
segments.comment: Initial address. For the offset AGU this is the starting lane offset; for the input AGU it is ignored.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Selects which AGU the repetition applies to.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Selects which AGU the repetition extension applies to.

segments.name: iter
segments.comment: most significant bits to apply to the `iter` value of the repetition operator.

segments.name: step
segments.comment: most significant bits to apply to the `step` value of the repetition operator.

segments.name: delay
segments.comment: most significant bits to apply to the `delay` value of the repetition operator.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Selects which AGU the transition applies to.
